strategyComparison.winRateDefinition: TP1 reached and not subsequently stopped; TP1 followed by a stop is excluded from wins and reported separately as stopped_after_tp1.
strategyComparison.realizedRNote: Average realized R includes only unambiguous TP2 (+3R) and full stop-loss (-1R) outcomes. stopped_after_tp1 is excluded until a partial-exit rule is explicitly defined.
strategyComparison.sourceNote: Forward-only metrics use signals first generated on new completed M15 candles and exclude historical backfill. Historical backfill remains archived separately. These are analytical signals, not executed demo trades.

R_10.note: Only continuous segments with at least 400 M15 candles are evaluated. Discovery uses the first 50%; the later 50% is held out for validation. Entry is next candle open. Shared exits: 1.5 ATR stop, TP1=2R, TP2=3R, 96-candle horizon. Same-candle stop/target touches are ambiguous. A candidate is shown in validation only after at least 10 resolved validation signals. Expired trades are reported, not counted as wins or losses. This is exploratory research, not a live strategy.

strategyResearch.caution: Pooled results combine multiple markets and are exploratory. Require adequate independent validation samples and subsequent forward-shadow results before promoting any rule.

expiryAnalysis.note: Favourable excursion is maximum recorded candle movement divided by risk distance; it is not proof of execution or realised profit. Missing historical timestamps remain missing and are not reconstructed.

reviewComparison.note: Original journal outcome and current candle-based advisory review are separate observations. Advisory statuses never overwrite journal outcomes and do not prove broker execution.

breakoutRetestShadow.strategy: M5 breakout beyond prior 12-bar range; M1 retest confirmation; next-M1-open entry
breakoutRetestShadow.note: Research-only forward shadow. Historical M1-entry results are not the production M5/M15 signal rules. M15 context is recorded, not used as a directional filter. No Telegram alerts or MT5 execution.

m5EmaPullbackShadow.strategy: M15 EMA20/50 signal; M5 EMA9/21 alignment and EMA9 pullback/reclaim; next-M5-open entry; 2R target; 1-hour horizon

breakoutRetestM5M15Shadow.strategy: M5 breakout beyond prior 12 M5 candles; only aligned, fully closed M15 EMA20/50 trend; M5 retest confirmation; next-M5-open entry

productionManagementSimulation.weighting: Two equal-sized entries close at +1.5R; the third closes at +3R or stop. Weighted basket R is +2R at TP2 and +0.667R if the runner stops after TP1.

comparisonModel.note: Same single 2R target and one-hour horizon as the M1 research candidate for entry comparison. A separate outcome stream simulates the approved three-entry TP1 1.5R / TP2 3R management.

productionCompatibility.productionTargetManagement: TP1 1.5R on first two entries; TP2 3R on third entry

breakoutRetestM5M15Shadow.note: No Telegram alerts, no production signal routing, and no MT5 execution. M15 direction must be confirmed by the last fully closed M15 candle; incomplete M15 candles are excluded.
